brand.beakbound.note: Stays in Latin letters, never transliterated.

char.pip.note: Transliteration; masculine, declines (Пипа, Пипу), as Dickens's Pip in Russian.

char.peaches.note: Transliteration; feminine, indeclinable. Peach jokes use «персик/персиковый». Stress Пи́чес.

char.minty.note: Transliteration; masculine, indeclinable. Mint jokes use «мята/мятный» (Minty links it: «Мята — почти Минти!»).

char.orbit.note: Transliteration (stress О́рбит); feminine, indeclinable like Кармен. «орбита» stays an ordinary noun.

char.postmaster-bill.note: Title lowercase in running text (capital at sentence start); Билл declines (Билла, Биллу).

char.courier.note: One word everywhere (story, flight, «Королевский курьер», «Курьер Пип»). Grammatically masculine, used generically for every bird; shared lines never make adjectives or past verbs agree with the speaker.

char.narrator.note: Never shown; captions address the player with ты, gender-neutral.

boss.baron-bat.note: «Нетопырь» = the old fairy-tale word for a bat: masculine, posh, rings like a title. Short «Барон». Ordinary enemy bats stay «летучие мыши».

boss.spitter-king.note: King of the spitter beetles («жуки-плевуны»), same «плевун» root. Bill: «Король»; birds: «Ваше Величество».

boss.pirate-captain.note: Short «Капитан»; he calls himself «Капитан» in the third person.

boss.ember-dragon.note: «Тлеющий» = smouldering like embers (old fire that still bites); embers = «тлеющие угли». Short «Дракон».

guardian.king-coo.note: Adapted: «курлык» is the Russian pigeon coo; К–К echoes King Kong. Card shout «КУРЛЫК!».

guardian.searchlight-gargoyle.note: Splits ПРОЖЕКТОРНАЯ / ГОРГУЛЬЯ. «Горгулья» is a feminine noun though he is male: lines avoid past tense/adjectives agreeing with it («Горгулья принимает предложение»).

npc.firefly-nursery.note: «Ясли» = crèche for babies (not a plant nursery); speaks as «мы».

npc.baker.note: Feminine; distinct from the volcano baker.

npc.unit-7.note: Robot designation; thanks in robotic CAPITALS.

npc.parrot.note: Capitalised when the Captain addresses him; masculine.

title.postmaster.note: Old-fashioned, friendly word for the head of a post office; works alone («Приказ почтмейстера»).

title.keeper-of-the-lost-letter.note: Singular, echoed by the plural job title.

title.commissioner.note: Police commissioner; third person «Комиссар принимает предложение».

place.city-of-light.note: Established epithet of Paris (la Ville Lumière).

place.edge-of-the-map.note: «на краю карты» in speech; «Край карты» as a name/address.

place.sugarloaf-mountain.note: The Russian name keeps the sugar (Pip's joke works).

place.theatre-marquee.note: The lit canopy over the theatre door.

chapter.lamplight-line.note: Street lamps are «фонари»; Ф–Л sound, keeps the lamp image.

level.3-1.note: Adapted from «лететь, как мотылёк на свет».

level.3-4.note: Same words as the Gargoyle's arrival headline.

level.3-7.note: Russian title of the film "Midnight Express" too.

level.4-5.note: The highest (spring) tide, not the season.

level.5-6.note: Established name of the Lantern Festival.

level.5-7.note: Adapted: the Russian idiom for the last leg of a journey.

cargo.1-2.en: Star charts for the sloth stargazer

cargo.1-4.en: Feather boas for the carnival parade

cargo.1-5.en: A rush invitation for the drum captain

cargo.1-8.en: A final notice for Baron Bat

cargo.2-6.en: A feather duster for the caretaker

cargo.2-7.en: Lamp oil for the lantern sellers

cargo.2-8.en: Water flasks for the long caravan
cargo.2-8.target: Фляги с водой для долгого каравана

cargo.2-9.en: A stop-brewing order for the Spitter King

cargo.3-1.en: Light bulbs for the theatre marquee

cargo.3-3.en: Hot pretzels for the night-shift cabbies

cargo.3-4.en: A weather vane for the tallest tower

cargo.3-6.en: Sheet music for the accordion player

cargo.3-7.en: A midnight love letter for the baker

cargo.3-8.en: A wake-up call for the Dusk Empress
cargo.3-8.note: «Побудка» = reveille: a wake-up and a warning.

cargo.4-1.en: A new lens for the lighthouse keeper

cargo.4-2.en: Oven mitts for the volcano baker

cargo.4-3.en: Kite string for the beach festival
cargo.4-3.target: Нить для змеев на пляжный праздник

cargo.4-4.en: A reply for the island hermit

cargo.4-5.en: A tide table for the ferry crew

cargo.4-6.en: Fish biscuits for the gull colony

cargo.4-7.en: Dry socks for the storm-watch sailors

cargo.4-8.en: A return-the-mail order for the Captain

cargo.5-1.en: Woolly hats for the penguin choir

cargo.5-2.en: Hot cocoa for the polar station

cargo.5-3.en: Spare fuses for the noodle bar sign

cargo.5-4.en: A paper letter for a curious robot

cargo.5-5.en: Race tickets for the rooftop runners
cargo.5-5.target: Билеты на забег бегунам по крышам

cargo.5-8.en: The first letter ever sent to the Dragon

enemy.purple-bat.note: Plain «летучая мышь» in lines (also the Baron's, swarm and mummy bats).

enemy.mummy-bat.note: «ЛЕТУЧИЕ МЫШИ-МУМИИ»; same bat word as the plain bats.

attack.screech.note: Bill's «визжит, да не кусает» uses the same root.

attack.seed.note: Plural «семечки»: spitting seeds is a familiar image.

attack.lamp.note: The Gargoyle's chest lamp (city street lamps are «фонари»).

attack.mail-call.note: Adapted: the short Russian "you've got mail" shout.

attack.ankh.note: Standard Russian name of the symbol.

hazard.gate.note: Plural-only noun; counts read «N ворот»; «проход/просвет» for the gap.

hazard.switchback.note: Zigzag road: «вверх в один проход, вниз в другой».

hazard.steam-geyser.note: NY steam comes from street manholes; «горячие» / «мягкие».

set-piece.skyfall.note: Coined like the English: the sky falling (meteors); avoids «звездопад», which would clash with collectible stars.

pickup.star.note: One word for pickup, rating and wallet.

pickup.heart.note: Life hearts; Peaches's love/heart double meaning works.

weapon.sprint.note: Same in button, hints and upgrades.

mode.tap-and-fly.note: Pattern shared with the other «… и лети».

ui.postcard.note: «Дорогой курьер,» agrees with the noun «курьер», fine for any bird; «P.S.».

ui.guardian.note: Masculine noun used generically; Bill says «страж».

ui.bonk.note: Cartoon bump; the Empress's moths say the softer «Тюк».

ui.to-be-continued.note: Exact caption for the scene player.

ui.workout.note: Light word, keeps mini games casual (practice is «тренировка»).

achievement.out-of-the-spotlight.note: Adapted: out of his light and off the stage.

achievement.bright-lights.note: Echoes the Chaplin title known in Russian.

story.flame-seal.note: «печать в виде пламени»; «Два маршрута, две печати».

story.warm-letter.note: Both meanings (warm and kind) work in Russian.

story.mail-route.note: One word in chapters, boss and Bill lines, HUD.

story.pigeonholes.note: Adapted pun: the sorting shelves as a dovecote that has never housed a pigeon.

story.bagel.note: «Бублик» is the familiar Russian ring bread.

story.letter-phrases.note: Russian stock letter phrases; flight recipe: «Выздоравливай», «С любовью».

story.beauty-sleep.note: Used the same way in every line.

story.lamps.note: Street lamps; no near-homophone in the takes.

story.first-letter.en: the first letter ever sent to the Dragon

story.dotted-i.en: He dotted his “i” with a tiny bat.
story.dotted-i.target: А вместо точки — крохотная летучая мышка.
story.dotted-i.note: Adapted: Cyrillic has no dotted i, so the bat replaces the full stop of his signature.

motto.every-letter-lands.note: "Долетит" = arrives by flying all the way (arriving + a bird landing); works as a question: «Каждое письмо правда долетит?».

address.little-courier.note: Diminutive: posh condescension with no adjective agreement.

address.postie.note: Colloquial old word for a postman.

address.sprat.note: Literally a sprat; a common small-fry put-down.

address.lad.note: Sailors' word for a greenhorn; common gender, no "boy".

address.fledgling.note: Fussy old man's word for a greenhorn.

address.peaches-pet-names.note: Varied, never repeated: солнышко, пончик, лапочка, булочка, пупсик, ягодка, конфетка, милашка…

address.minions.en: Cousins! / my lovelies / my little scarabs / me hearties
address.minions.target: Кузены! / мои милые / мои скарабейчики / Свистать всех наверх!

phrase.baron-bat-line.en: This route is my roost now, little courier!
phrase.baron-bat-line.target: Этот маршрут теперь мой насест, курьерчик!

phrase.spitter-king-line.en: Every letter on my road goes in the brew!
phrase.spitter-king-line.target: Каждое письмо на моей дороге — в варево!

phrase.dusk-empress-line.en: Hush now. The night mail is sleeping.
phrase.dusk-empress-line.target: Тише, тише. Ночная почта сладко спит.

phrase.pirate-captain-line.en: Arr! Every mailbag on these waves be mine!
phrase.pirate-captain-line.target: Арр! Все почтовые мешки на этих волнах — мои!

phrase.ember-dragon-line.en: The sky is mine. Your letters are kindling.
phrase.ember-dragon-line.target: Это небо — моё. Твои письма — лишь растопка.

phrase.neferhoo-line.en: Return to sender! This route has a courier.
phrase.neferhoo-line.target: Вернуть отправителю! У этого маршрута уже есть курьер.

phrase.king-coo-line.en: Nobody flies till the bread cart is found!
phrase.king-coo-line.target: Никто не летает, пока не найдётся хлебная тележка!

phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.en: Hold still! Nobody ever stays in the light.
phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.target: Замри! Никто никогда не задерживается в луче.

phrase.return-to-sender.note: The usual Russian wording of the postal formula; identical in every use.

phrase.peaches-tagline.en: Rosy cheeks, curly crest, all heart.
phrase.peaches-tagline.target: Румяные щёчки, кудрявый хохолок, большое сердце.

phrase.minty-tagline.en: Tiny hummer. Fresh sprig. Full speed.

phrase.orbit-tagline.en: A dreamy owl who flies by starlight.
phrase.orbit-tagline.target: Мечтательная сова, что летает при свете звёзд.

phrase.no-flame-seal.en: No flame seal on this guardian.
phrase.no-flame-seal.target: Огненной печати у этого стража нет.

phrase.sticks-and-stones.target: Слова — не камни? А камни у меня с собой!

phrase.pirate-speak.note: Йо-хо-хо!, Полундра!, Стоп машина!, Тысяча каракатиц!, Свистать всех наверх!, Парус на горизонте!

phrase.accepts.note: Gargoyle: «Горгулья принимает предложение.» (present tense, no gender clash).

phrase.bonk-bonk.note: Soft bump of a moth on a lamp.

story.letter.note: Same word as in the motto.

story.mail-and-post.note: One word for both; «почтальон» for postman.

story.salutation.note: «Дорогой курьер,» agrees with the noun, fits any bird.

ui.pickups.note: Settings and generic UI; concrete lists name «звёзды и сердечки». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.tap-verb.note: «Жми» in flight hints and modes («Жми и лети»); «нажми» in menus and the builder. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.test-fly.note: Key «ИСПЫТАТЬ», «Испытай уровень до финиша»; the flight itself is «пробный полёт» (mode.test-flight). UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.level-builder-key.note: Short form on the home key and buttons; screen title «Конструктор уровней». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.gate-look.note: Kept apart from «вид ворот» (gate family). UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.escaped.note: Plural «мы» forms: no gender agreement with the bird. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.hp.note: «ОЗ» (очки здоровья) beside the big number; «ЗДОРОВЬЕ» in labels. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.stamped.note: Passport postmark word and the daily-card pill. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.spotted.note: UI shout over any bird: impersonal plural, no gender (replaces «ЗАМЕЧЕН!» from attack.beam on the tag). UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.boss-bar-defeated.note: Neutral: «ПОВЕРЖЕН/ПОВЕРЖЕНА» would need the boss's gender; the banner has one branch per boss and agrees. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.new-tag.note: Neutral sticker word; level card tag is «НОВОЕ» too. A new bird in screen-reader text is «новичок». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.neferhoo-roar.note: The hoopoe's call in Russian is «уп-уп-уп». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.cloud-save.note: Play Games strip; «Облако и достижения». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.gate-counts.target: N ворот / пролети сквозь ворота N раз
ui.gate-counts.note: «Ворота» is plural-only: short labels use «ворот» (1 → «ворота»); goal sentences count passes («N раз»); the old Classic score unit is «препятствие/-я/-й». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.short.dusk-empress.note: Only boss_duskMoth_name (budget 20); everywhere else «Сумеречная Императрица». Builder key: «Сумеречная». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.short.searchlight-gargoyle.note: Only boss_searchlightGargoyle_name (budget 20); the name card, banner and story keep «Прожекторная Горгулья». UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.short.push-up-flight.note: Fits the «… и лети» pattern; «Полёт на отжиманиях» is 19. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).

ui.short.all-rounder.note: «Мастер на все крылья» is 20; used in the passport and the 3 Play achievements. UI translator (reports/ui-ru.md).
